architectureDecision.reason: Approved scope is one static Astro marketing page with fixed content and native placeholder links. Requirements and specification explicitly exclude backend APIs, authentication, persistence, analytics/tracking, visitor data, additional routes, dynamic loading/error workflows, and require no client-side JavaScript for approved interactions. The repository has one Astro dependency, default Astro configuration, and an existing Vercel project-root build policy; responsive thresholds, component/file organization, asset handling, and validation sequencing are implementation-planning concerns rather than meaningful cross-cutting system boundaries.
